record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: Let M be a closed aspherical manifold whose fundamental group has nontrivial centre. Is M null-cobordant, that is, does its cobordism class vanish?

evidence.quote: Given a closed aspherical manifold M whose fundamental group has nontrivial centre, we can ask the following: Question B. Is such an M null-cobordant?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A connected closed manifold $M$ is called aspherical if its universal cover is contractible, equivalently if all higher homotopy groups $\pi_k(M)$ vanish for $k \geq 2$. Recall that two closed $n$-dimensional manifolds $M_0$ and $M_1$ are (unoriented) cobordant if there exists a compact $(n+1)$-dimensional manifold $W$ with boundary $\partial W = M_0 \sqcup M_1$; a closed $n$-manifold $M$ is null-cobordant if it is cobordant to the empty manifold, i.e., if it bounds a compact $(n+1)$-manifold. The center $Z(G)$ of a group $G$ is the subgroup of elements commuting with every element of $G$.

Question: Let $M$ be a closed aspherical manifold whose fundamental group $\pi_1(M)$ has nontrivial center. Must $M$ be null-cobordant?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether every closed aspherical manifold with nontrivial center in its fundamental group is null-cobordant appears in standard collections of open problems on the topology of manifolds and is widely cited as open. Related results (e.g., Cappell–Weinberger–Yan constructions of aspherical manifolds with center but without circle actions) address adjacent but distinct questions; no proof or counterexample to the null-cobordism question itself appears in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Closed Aspherical Manifolds with Center
status_evidence.snippet: In all dimensions greater than 7, there are closed aspherical manifolds whose fundamental groups have nontrivial center but which admit no topological circle actions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies aspherical manifolds with nontrivial center but does not resolve the null-cobordism question.

status_evidence.title: Aspherical manifolds - Manifold Atlas
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of conjectures and open problems concerning closed aspherical manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Standard surveys list cobordism-type questions for aspherical manifolds among the open problems.
